Class ElementsResponse<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.ElementsResponse<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of an element
All Implemented Interfaces:
AttributeHolder, MutableAttributeHolder, HttpMessage<BodyElements<T>>, HttpResponse<BodyElements<T>>
@Internal public final class ElementsResponse<T> extends Object implements HttpResponse<BodyElements<T>>
The response of an asynchronous streaming exchange: the status and the headers of the response, and the elements of its body as the body.
